_about: Roblox's in-game menu (top bar menu button and SettingsHub), recorded by dump.luau beside this file from a running Studio client. Measured values only; see dump.luau's header for the format.

notes.animationsHowTo: Each animation is RenderStepped samples from armAnimation (the last three frames before anything changed, then every frame until 1 s after the last change); t is seconds since arming; columns name the instance (see WATCH in dump.luau) and property; events are UserInputService.InputBegan and GuiService.MenuOpened/MenuClosed. The client ran at about 60 frames a second; the first frame after a key often takes longer (the menu builds its page).
notes.blur: The place has its own BlurEffect (Lighting.Blur, Size 12, enabled throughout); the menu adds no BlurEffect of its own to the Camera or Lighting: blurSizes in the animations stays [12] open and shut.
notes.buttonHover: hover-button-leave: with the mouse on Leave (People tab), MenuButton's BackgroundTransparency goes 0.88 -> 0.8096 and stays there (read again after 1.5 s); nothing else under BottomButtonFrame changes.
notes.coordinates: (Added by hand after the run.) AbsolutePosition is in GUI space, which starts under the 58-pixel top bar inset (guiInsetTopLeft), also for IgnoreGuiInset ScreenGuis: the screen's top edge is y = -58. mouseLocation is in screen space.
notes.iconHover: closed-icon-hover: with the mouse on the menu button, IconHitArea/StateOverlayRound shows (208, 217, 251) at 0.92; compare its values in closed.
notes.inputs: Inputs were sent with the Studio MCP's user_keyboard_input (Escape) and user_mouse_input (moveTo an instance path, click); its x/y are in GUI space below the 58-pixel inset, GetMouseLocation (mouseLocation) is in screen space. Its moveTo glides the cursor over about 0.3 s, so rows on the way get hovered.
notes.rowHover: A Settings row is highlighted by BackgroundTransparency 1 -> 0 over its BackgroundColor3 (35, 37, 39), set the frame the mouse enters it (no tween seen at 60 fps). Leaving a row for the backdrop doesn't clear it: the last row the mouse crossed stays highlighted until another row is entered. So in open-settings the Automatic Translations row is highlighted (the mouse crossed it on its way out of the panel); hover-row-output-device has the mouse resting on Output Device.
notes.smallWindow: small-* entries: a custom Device Simulator device (Desktop form, 630x990, PixelDensity 96, ScalingMode ActualResolution, orientation LandscapeRight) set from the client DataModel during Play; GuiInset stays (0, 58); TouchEnabled false. The device was removed afterwards.
notes.styles: (Added by hand after the run.) Properties were read directly, not through Instance:GetStyled. Foundation components styled through StyleSheets (subtrees beside a FoundationCursorContainer: the Settings page's HeaderWrapper and DividerWrapper, BottomButtonFrame's buttons, the People, Gallery, Report and Help pages, TopBarApp's MenuIconHolder) can show class-default FontFace, TextSize, TextColor3 and background values where a style draws something else, e.g. the section headers' Text reads LegacyArial 8 while its TextBounds are 155x25 for 'View & Controls'. Absolute*, TextBounds and layout are computed after styling and hold everywhere; the SettingsHub rows, tabs, panel, sliders, selectors and dropdowns set their properties directly. dump.luau's M.STYLED reads through GetStyled for a re-take.
